query: 2025年第一季度的GMV是多少
generated_sql:

FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id

query: 2025年3月每天的销售额分别是多少
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    dd.date_id AS 日期,
    SUM(fo.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.date_id BETWEEN 20250301 AND 20250331
GROUP BY dd.date_id
ORDER BY dd.date_id;

query: 2025年1月份哪天卖得最好
generated_sql:
SELECT d.date_id, SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_amount
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025 AND d.month = 1
GROUP BY d.date_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

query: 各品类的销售额分别是多少

query: 各省份的订单数量分别是多少

query: 各品牌的销量分别是多少
generated_sql:

    dp.brand,
    SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS total_quantity

query: 各品类2025年1月份的销售额占比是多少
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    dp.category,
    ROUND(SUM(fo.order_amount) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(fo.order_amount)) OVER (), 2) AS sales_ratio
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.month = 1
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY sales_ratio DESC;

query: 各大区的销售额占比是多少
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    r.region_name AS 大区,
    ROUND(SUM(f.order_amount) / (SELECT SUM(order_amount) FROM fact_order) * 100, 2) AS 销售额占比
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY 销售额占比 DESC;

query: 手机数码品类的销售额占总销售额的比例是多少
generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.category = '手机数码' THEN f.order_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.order_amount) * 100, 2) AS sales_ratio_percent FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product d ON f.product_id = d.product_id;
